patches.name: AMOLED Black & Bottom Bar Transparency
patches.description: Adds adjustable toolbar and bottom bar transparency with frosted-glass blur and pure AMOLED black mode for the browser interface.

patches.name: Auto-close unused tabs: After 1 day
patches.description: Adds an 'After 1 day' option to the Auto-close unused tabs setting.

patches.name: Block third-party cookies by default
patches.description: Blocks third-party cookies by default across all websites, with an option to re-enable them in Settings.

patches.name: Built-in Google Translate engine
patches.description: Adds a built-in page translation engine with automatic translation and quick language settings.

patches.name: Change package and app name
patches.description: Changes the package name, custom permissions, provider authorities, internal content:// URIs, UriMatcher rules, app display name, and launcher icon (SBrowserX X logo or original Samsung Internet icon) so SBrowserX runs cleanly alongside or independently of stock Samsung Internet.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Custom Android package name for the patched browser.

options.title: App name
options.description: Custom launcher display name for the patched browser.

options.title: App icon
options.description: Choose between the SBrowserX icon with the X logo (default) or the original Samsung Internet icon.

patches.name: Disable Update Prompts & Badges
patches.description: Hides store update prompts, banners, and update badges.

patches.name: External downloader support
patches.description: Sends file, image, video, and link downloads to your chosen external download manager.

patches.name: Remove 99-Tab Limit
patches.description: Removes the 99-tab limit so you can keep thousands of open tabs.

patches.name: Remove telemetry, promotions & updates
patches.description: Removes built-in analytics, promotional banners, shopping ads, and background update checks while keeping website notifications working.

patches.name: SBrowserX Settings, Extensions & Privacy Core
patches.description: Adds SBrowserX settings hub and mirrors all toggles natively in-place across Samsung Internet's settings sections.

patches.name: Third-Party Autofill Support
patches.description: Enables native Android Autofill (Bitwarden, Gboard inline suggestions), removes Samsung Pass prompts, and unlocks local credit cards without Knox.

patches.name: Unified Dark Mode & True AMOLED Websites
patches.description: Synchronizes website dark mode with the browser theme, removes dim overlays, and applies pure AMOLED black backgrounds when enabled.

patches.name: Unlock Chrome Web Store & Extensions
patches.description: Enables extension support, unlocks the Chrome Web Store, and allows installing and keeping third-party extensions.

patches.name: Unlock Compact Layout
patches.description: Unlocks the compact floating toolbar layout, smooths scrolling behavior, and lets you customize the extra toolbar button.

patches.name: Unlock Debug settings menu
patches.description: Reveals the hidden Debug settings menu inside browser Settings.
